idea-plugin.name: Maven Central MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Runs a local Model Context Protocol server inside the IDE so that MCP clients (for example Cursor, Claude Code or VS Code) can search Maven Central and inspect artifact versions.
  • search_artifacts – find artifacts by name, with pagination
  • get_artifact_info – metadata for one exact coordinate
  • get_latest_version – newest published vs. newest stable version, using Maven version ordering
  • get_versions – paginated version list with prerelease flags
The server uses MCP Streamable HTTP at http://127.0.0.1:47115/mcp (port configurable in Settings | Tools | Maven Central MCP), listens on the loopback interface only, is read-only, and never reads or modifies project files. No account, telemetry or hosted backend.
